title: ofelia-object
description: `ofelia` runs Lua scripts in Pure Data, with `ofelia define` creating an editable script/module and `ofelia function` wrapping a script as a function. Related objects such as `ofelia get`, `ofelia set`, and `ofelia exists` access variables, update variables or call functions, and check whether a named object exists. The optional `-c` and `-s` flags set control and signal inlet/outlet counts, while `-k` keeps script contents.
